balls.text: Johnson walks across outside off, and ramps the full toss over short fine leg
drives a full delivery to sweeper cover
Starc angles it in from round the stumps, Shivam makes room and swings, the yorker slips under the arc and hits the stumps second time in the over
Shivam on IPL debut gets a short ball outside off, and steers it in the air, fine to the third man rope
he tries to make some room, but Starc is fast, right in the blockhole, and into middle stump before Patel can do anything about it
angles it into the left hander, who misses, and the ball goes square on the off side
full delivery drilled down to long off
slashes hard and it flies to Harshal at third man, he takes it inches inside the rope, the momentum takes him over, he releases the ball just before, and prevents the six
lifts this full delivery on the bounce to long off
in the blockhole just outside off at 142 kph, Johnson cannot connect
Johnson swings and misses again, as Aaron angles this slower one across him
length ball on middle and leg worked down to long on
another slower one, Johnson swings at the length ball close to off and misses
a wide slower one, Saha mishits it high and AB comes in from long off to take it, he then throws it right back at Harshal and the bowler goes down, he's taken some blows this over
Saha drives a full delivery past Gayle's dive at point and they take two more
full and wide, Johnson stretches for it and squeezes it past the bowler
he's smashed this low full toss straight into the bowler's left shin, it;s hit so hard it ricochets far enough for them to take two
there is no Miller, but Harshal goes for six first ball of the over as Johnson flicks a length ball angled in over square leg
full on middle, turned in front of square leg for a couple
tries to pull another short ball, just drags it past the bowler to long on
ripper to fellow fast bowler first up, sharp bouncer at 144 kph, Johnson hops and fends it square on the off side

he's tried to place this full toss wide of sweeper cover again, but he has to clear extra cover first, and Chahal has dived to his right to take a sharp catch there, but his effort could be in vain, Aaron seems to have just overstepped, his foot is on the line, but does not seem to have any part behind it, but Miller's been given, oh well
full and wide outside off, Miller stretches for it, misses
shot, Aaron angles it across on a length, there is plenty of width, Miller needs to place his punch, and he does it, past Starc's dive at sweeper cover
Saha gets hold of one now, this is his favoured stroke, takes this full one from well outside off and sweeps it just over the deep square leg rope
hit to Gayle at backward point
he bangs it in short, it rises slowly but too high, Miller lets it go
a slower length ball, Miller picks it from outside off again and checks the stroke over midwicket, Starc runs around to it
another boundary, this is short and angled in down the leg side, Miller's pulled it behind square, Chahal dives but it slips through
a length ball from round the stumps, Miller's reached for it and sent it soaring onto the roof of the stadium beyond the long on boundary, 50 off 23 balls for Miller
Starc in business at deep midwicket again? No, this shortish ball is pulled just over the tall man's jump
full and wide, Saha reaches for it and misses
angled short of a length down the pads, but Miller cannot swat it too wide of fine leg
walks down the track and turns this length ball to long on
opens the face and guides it wide of third man, and scurries back for the second
Saha is costing his side some momentum, this is short and wide, and he's chopped it weakly to point
Saha walks outside off but his push to this full ball finds short extra cover
Saha steps out and turns this fullish delivery to long on
another wrong 'un, widish outside off, Miller slaps it to the sweeper
nudged off the pad to short fine leg
shortish googly, Miller comes across and punches to long on
skips out and pushes along the ground to long off
pushes a full one to short extra cover
Starc bowls it short and widish, Miller opens the face and guides it just past backward point, timed too well for third man
this has almost gone flat for six, incredible hit, Miller's made some room, come forward and punched it over mid off, the strike is so clean it falls inches inside the rope
short and wide, Miller accepts the offering and comes forward to smash it well out of the reach of sweeper cover
full and wide, Saha reaches for it and squeezes it  between extra cover and mid off, hasn';t timed it, and AB stops it with a dive
takes a hand off the bat handle as he pushes at this length ball angled across him, cannot get the single
141 kph length ball slips down the leg side
short of a length, into the left hander, turned square on leg
fuller just outside off, Saha leans forward to push to short extra cover
good delivery, coming in a bit towards off, good length, Saha pushes off the front foot to point
Bailey's gone, he never looked in touch tonight, Morkel angles it in, just short of a length, close to off, Bailey goes pushing at it, and edges it behind
closer to off stump now, Bailey tries to run it past point, cannot beat Gayle there
back of a length, wide, but Bailey can only chop it to point
angles it in on a length, is pushed down the ground
Bailey is having a hard time dealing with Chahal, he goes back to a flat and quick legbreak that spins away a touch and beats his waft
flat at 87.5 kph, Miller goes back and slaps it to the sweeper
full and angled across just outside off, it does not turn, Miller picks it from there and hammers it over way over long on
flights it full on the pad, Miller clips it to midwicket
low full toss pushed down to long on
nicely bowled, Bailey pushes forward to a flighted legbreak that dips, spins and bounces past the outside edge
no stopping this one, Miller is forward to a pitched up delivery and drives it past extra cover
overpitched, Miller clobbers it to the left of the sweeper, but Yuvraj reaches there with a dive to stop the boundary
beats him with a 144.5 kph back of a length ball that is angled in but holds the line even as Miller pushes forward
short ball, 138.4 kph, Miller swivels and pulls in front of square leg, there is a man in the deep, he has no chance as it is placed well wide of him
short of a length, punched to the off side, extra cover comes across to field
shortish, fast, wide, Miller cuts it in a flash to the deep backward point boundary

not something you see often in T20, Bailey's padded up to this tossed up googly, what a ball to get first up, didn't pick it, thought he could leave it alone, he is hit just outside the line of off stump on the flap of the right pad, but the appeal is turned down

Maxwell lives and falls by the slog sweep, Chahal bowls a flat legbreak on middle, Maxwell goes down on his knee and swats it, Starc is around on the edge of the deep midwicket rope, and it helps that he is tall
flat, quick and wide, cut to sweeper cover
goes back and across and pushes at one angled across, the ball runs to backward point, who fails to stop it
Maxwell slog sweeps, flat and on the bounce to deep midwicket
flat and slanted across the left hander, punched to the sweeper
Yuvraj beats him last ball with one bowled slower outside off, Maxwell slogs and misses
drags it short once more, Maxwell pulls again, and this time it flies to the deep midwicket rope
sprays it short and wide down leg, Maxwell swivels for a big pull but misses
and again, Yuvraj bowls it wider, but Maxwell is down in a flash and smacks it straight again
Maxwell tees off early, he comes out, and swipes it hard and high and straight, short followthrough, but so effective
skips out, and works this off the pad behind square leg
full delivery worked through midwicket
flat delivery forced wide of long on but Kohli charges across to keep them to one
Sehwag falls in the first over of spin, charges out to a flighted ball on off, tries to launch Chahal over long on but he's only gone as far as the fielder
turned through vacant midwicket for a single
legbreak with some width, Sehwag rocks back and cuts hard, but sweeper keeps them to only a single
legbreak straightening on middle, worked in front of square leg
Sehwag goes back to a length ball which straightens and stays low, but he pushes it down to long on without trouble
he is away with a four first ball, a full toss outside off, Maxwell opens the face, places it past backward point, and his timing is good enough to beat third man
Mandeep's tried to launch this full and wide one down the ground, but he's mishit it tamely to mid on, he's struggled to time the ball tonight, and the struggle is over now
opens the face and runs this length ball around off to third man

RCB keep leaking runs, Mandeep jabs this one close to the pitch on the leg side, bowler rushes for it, a direct hit could have had Mandeep in trouble, but Harshal's throw is so wild, mid off cannot stop it from rolling into the boundary even with a dive
the wide problems continue for RCB, Harshal sends a slower one down leg now
very full and into the pad, whipped straight to deep square leg
yet another ball slanted down leg
just clears mid off's jump, Harshal pitches it up outside off, Sehwag does not move the feet at all., but smashes it cleanly as he reaches out with the bat
131 kph full toss sent miles down the leg side to start off, Parthiv does well to stop it with a dive
145 kph again, tight line just outside off, just short of a length, Sehwag guides it to point
145 kph from Aaron, but of little use as it is sprayed well down the leg side
short of a length, Sehwag goes back and works it in front of square, they hesitate till it beats the fielder's dive and then run
the next ball is pitched up, but Mandeep handles it well, pushes it late and softly in front of extra cover
a bouncer at 142 kph, into the batsman, around shoulder height, Mandeep hooks hard, and the top edge flies over the keeper
just short of a length, towards the pad, Sehwag helps it to fine leg
clear run out chance but AB cannot pick up the ball as he runs in from extra cover, Aaron started with a quick and full one that Mandee[p dug out to the off side
makes room now, this does not come in, and Sehwag swats the length ball over point
Sehwag survives as he plays from the crease, Morkel has been moving them in sharply after pitching but the batsman gets an inside edge onto pad
makes some room outside leg, steps out, tries to bash this back of a length ball through the off side, but mishits it to mid off
Starc does well to run across from third man, dive and stop it just in front of the rope, Mandeep had cut this hard and it was travelling
goes back and whips this incoming delivery through square leg, the man from the deep rushes in to prevent the second
hit high on the pad off an inside edge as this jags in after pitching, Sehwag pushes Mandeep for the single as the ball rolls towards slip
Sehwag cannot do anything with the free hit again, Starc angles it in close to off, good length, Sehwag swings and misses
he bowls a slower one outside off, Sehwag cannot reach it, keeper and bowler cannot believe it is called wide, they are right too, that was well inside the marker
pitched up into the pad, they take a single as the ball rolls square on the leg side, and Starc has also overstepped
worked off the pad to square leg
opens the face and pushes softly at this one leaving him on the angle, it does not carry to Gayle's left at wide slip
slants this back of a length ball outside off, Sehwag ducks
nearly spooned it to backward point, Sehwag went after this back of a length ball, but could not time the punch, fell short of Yuvraj
leans forward and across this time to guide a length ball to third man
shot, not much width on this pitched up delivery, it was straightening too, Mandeep stayed beside the line and opened the face to square-drive through point
tries to go back and punch but it comes in again from just outside off, and the thick inside edge goes to square leg
Aaron throws and misses from short fine leg, but Sehwag would have been in even if it had it, Mandeep had worked a length ball with the angle to Aaron
spots some width on this short of a length ball and cuts hard, to cover, does not time it
a length ball close to off, Sehwag goes on the back foot and punches, they have a deep point for him
Morkel bowls a similar delivery, short of a length, coming into Sehwag, this time he is ready, moves back, hops, and works it past short fine leg
starts back of a length into the right-hander, Sehwag cannot work it away as he hops and is hit on the thigh pad
Mandeep beaten first ball with a 145 kph length ball that bounces and zips past his prod outside off
yet again on the pads, but Sehwag cannot get bat on this full delivery, it scoots to the right of square leg
fuller now, but starts leg stump and moves down the leg side
this length ball swings in but down the pads, and Sehwag tickles it fine
this one is slanted wider on a good length across Sehwag, he has a go at it, and is beaten
full one smacked right off the middle of the bat but straight to extra cover
first ball flies to the left of third man for four, Sehwag pushes at a full delivery that starts to come in outside off, and there is no stopping the thick edge
they will go down with a six, Aaron comes out and lofts this pitched up delivery over the wide long off boundary
charges out to a short and wide ball and flat-bats it over the bowler
pushes a length ball softly in front of cover for a single
length ball slanted down the leg side
reaches out, opens the face to a wide length ball and guides it wide of third man
Starc clears front leg and slices a slog high in the air, Miller wants the catch, he runs in a long way from long on, dives forward and holds on
Balaji falls as he bowls it way down the leg side, Starc helps it fine, Mandeep is in the deep, he he's fielded well today, but this time he lets it slip through his hands
tries to get under it for a slog, but it is too full and he drills it to long off instead
Aaron heaves at a wide one, toe-ends it to backward point
really slows it down by his standards at 85 kph, Starc waits and punches it to sweeper cover
forces it over cover out to the sweeper
slows it down, finds some turn, and beats him close to off
skips out, Patel bowls it wide at 99 kph, he slices it past point in the end
mishits a slog off a length ball to long on
a bouncer at 128 kph, Aaron has a swing at the hook and misses
slogs a slower one to Balaji at square leg
in the blockhole close to off and Starc misses
short ball, Starc flays it straight down the ground, long off gets to it
full and outside off, Starc bends the back leg and slices it over backward point
hit along the ground and down to long off
arches back and chops it behind point, Aaron takes it easy on the single, Maxwell throws it at the non-striker's end, had he hit, Aaron was gone, but the throw is wild, and nearly hits the umpire
has a go at the cut and is beaten
Johnson responds with a 144.5 kph short ball, Harshal tries to make room but it cramps him on leg stump, he opens the face and glides it straight to the keeper
he makes room, Johnson goes full for the stumps, but Harshal clears front leg and lifts it well over mid off
length ball into the pad, worked to fine leg
dropped, a slower short ball is lifted weakly over point, Sehwag runs back, gets to it, and puts it down
in the blockhole just outside off, guided to short third man
no miracle from AB tonight, Balaji goes full and wide, AB reaches out and slices it high and safely into the hands of sweeper cover
and another one, Balaji drops it short and harmless, AB powers it over deep midwicket, reaches 50, off 25

this has slipped out from Balaji's hands and turned into a very high full toss at AB, way above waist height, he bends the back knee and swats it over the fine leg boundary, what reflexes, what a player
wide length ball, AB hits it hard but not wide enough of the sweeper
Balaji starts with a slower bouncer that hits Starc on the left arm as he plays the pull too early
another full ball on the stumps, Starc drills it down to long on
full again, squeezed out to sweeper cover
Starc hammers this full delivery back at AB, who gets out of the way, and the ball flies into the straight boundary
a full toss, AB has a crack at it, only finds square leg
a yorker from round the stumps to AB, he makes room and forces it in front of square
Johnson gives the other Mitch a yorker, Starc digs it out and takes the single, Johnson kicks the ball but it misses the stumps
Starc gets hold of the slog-sweep, but only hits it on the bounce to long on
goes back and punches to extra cover
tries to slog this one angled in to middle, is beaten by big turn
Starc rocks back, slashes this 91 kph ball and it hurries to the third man boundary
comes out again, but can only mishit along the ground to long on
AB skips out, takes it on the full and hits it into the sightscreen, lone man fighting
length ball goes straight outside off and he is beaten
backs away to leg and pulls to deep midwicket
shortish, punched down to long on
full and quick, hit down to long on
tries to reverse hit it to third man but is beaten once more, the ball wasn't far from off
tries to go outside leg and pull but this is slanted in quick into him, and he misses
full just outside off, powered straight down the ground, long off runs around
pushed in the air down to long off
jumps out, takes it on the full and hits it to long on
AB will keep going, he comes out and goes through with the lofted shot, hits it over long on's jump
Morkel has had one hit too many, he goes back and tries to pull a length offbreak, Bailey takes the top edge at short third man
punched down to long off for a single
no catching this one, it is short from Maxwell and Morkel flays it high over long on

Albie clears front leg and slogs, it is a mammoth mishit, Miller keeps eyes on it as he runs to his left in front of the sightscreen, dives too, but the ball is already over the boundary as it hits his hand and rolls away
comes across and tries to sweep but misses as this goes down leg, it is a very late call from the umpire for a wide, it is the correct call though
sees him appear to skip out and sprays it short and wide outside off
length ball pushed to sweeper cover
goes hard again but mishits down to long off now
short delivery sitting up outside off, AB clobbers it over the bowler
chance goes, past Sehwag at slip, Albie tries to force this from the crease, thick edge brushes the keeper's leg and flies to Sehwag's right, just grazes his fingers
punches a length ball to extra cover

Yuvraj's struggle is over for tonight, he skips out, tries to go over midwicket, the turn takes the outside edge, and slip is waiting, Sehwag takes a sharp catch in front of his face, maiden IPL wicket for Shivam Sharma
jumps out, takes it on the full and swats it on the bounce to long off
lunges at the sweep and hits it through square leg, Mandeep has running to do in the deep again
lunges forward and nudges a quick ball off the pad to square leg
a straight length ball outside off, Yuvraj tries to dab it fine, misses
drives a full delivery to wide long off
AB goes straight over the bowler and beats the dive from Miller running across from long on
off the mark finally as he inside edges a slog to deep square leg
plenty of bounce as it comes in from a good length with the angle, cut to backward point
what an over on debut, Yuvraj in a tangle for the umpteenth time against spin, comes outside the crease again, tries to work it to leg, cannot put bat to ball
beaten yet again, he pushes forward to one angled in on off, it then jags sharply across, lot of turn there
loud appeal for leg before as Yuvraj misses the sweep on this full delivery, was that missing leg?
Yuvraj clueless again, he comes out and tries to work it to the leg side, it pops up square on off
Yuvraj is beaten on the forward push as Shivam spins and bounces it outside off
flat offbreak is pulled to deep midwicket
comes forward and defends a flighted ball just outside off
Akshar strikes now, Rana goes back to a quick and flat length delivery, it comes in with the angle, and crashes into middle stump
goes back to a flat length ball and pulls it to the right of long on
cut wide of Mandeep at sweeper cover
this is pushed in the air and fortunately for him, in the gap at cover, seemed to stop on him
a length ball bouncing around off, he goes back and swats it down to long on
a slower ball, full and under the bat, Rana has a crack at it and sends it sailing into the sightscreen
just over Miller at midwicket now as Rana flicks in the air off the pad
coming in from back of a length, punched to mid on
he's gone this time, Parthiv makes some room, comes out and tries to loft the length ball over the off side, he ends up slicing it, and they have a sweeper in place to take the catch
cracked over the bowler, Sandeep pitched it up to the stumps, Parthiv cranked up and flayed it back
tries to go over square leg again, but this is a slower length ball outside leg, and Parthiv is hit on the pad
short ball at 142.3 kph, he tries to ride the bounce and slash it, but is beaten
stays back to a pitched up delivery on the stumps and turns it to mid on
hes been eyeing the area for some time, flicks cleanly and high over square leg now, but there is a man in the deep
145.6 kph length ball, Parthiv tries to lift it over midwicket, but is beaten, it goes off the thigh pad to the keeper, appeal for caught behind turned down
now he tries to fetch it from outside off and pick it over square leg, connects very well but finds the man
Parthiv has powered Johnson over short extra cover for four, got some width on this length ball and gave it everything
short and wide once more, but this time he misses on the cut
full outside off now, he drives it quite crisply but cannot beat mid off
short and wide, he comes out of the crease and cuts it hard over point
straightening outside off once more, Rana punches it, it flies in the air just past Maxwell's dive at shortish backward point
widish again, punched to point
beaten as he wafts at a wide length ball that holds the line and stays low too
tries to cut the shortish one but is beaten
works this back of a length ball in the air and on the bounce to deep square leg
short of a length ball defended
very full just outside off and swinging in very late, dug out

this is a very, very late reaction from the umpire on the appeal, but he's given Kohli, the batsman moved across to a length ball which was angled down the leg side, tried to flick it, there was a clear sound as ball passed the bat, it was dying on the keeper, he took it in his right glove, but it seems to have just brushed the ground for an instant after that, they go to the third umpire, it is not a front-foot no-ball, and they think the catch is also clean
Sandeep's got Gayle again, anges it across Gayle, on a good length around off, it starts swinging away, Gayle goes after it, and edges it through to the keeper
bouncer at 142.8 kph, climbs high and Parthiv lets it go even as he moves outside the line
that could have gone too, it was a length ball on the pad, but Parthiv missed the flick, Johnson appeals for lbw, but it was headed down
shortish at 145 kph but Parthiv's swivelled and pulled it cleanly over square leg
moving away from back of a length, pushed to covers
pitched up delivery holds the line and is hammered straight to mid off
straightening after being angled in towards off, Parthiv works it to mid on
dropped, he's smacked it to the bowler, but that has burst out of Sandeep's hands and gone towards mid on
beaten again, as it swerves and bounces past him from just back of a length
that's raced to the long off boundary, mid off's dive is in vain, this was bowled much fuller, and Gayle worked it from just outside off, it was in the air as it flew just past the bowler
jags across him off a good length again, bounces too, Gayle takes a hand off the bat as he jabs it square
pitches outside leg and swinging across again, Gayle leans forward and defends
beats him first ball, pitches it on leg on a good length and swings it across pat Gayle's prod
